It covers fundamental concepts across computer vision, NLP, GANs, and more, using hands-on Jupyter Notebooks. summaries.en: Vibe-Trading is an open-source personal trading agent that integrates LLMs with multi-agent collaboration to automate market analysis and trade execution. Its core strength lies in combining real-time market data with AI-driven decision-making, enabling users to backtest strategies before deploying them live. You can customize agent roles, integrate with exchanges via APIs, and leverage MCP (Market Context Protocol) for structured data. Ideal for algorithmic traders and fintech enthusiasts seeking a flexible, AI-powered trading assistant.

summaries.en: video-use is an open-source tool that enables video editing through code, addressing the challenge of automating complex or repetitive editing tasks. Its core approach treats video manipulation as a programmable pipeline: a coding agent interprets natural language instructions or scripts to perform cuts, transitions, effects, and overlays. Technically, it integrates large language models with video processing libraries, allowing dynamic, context-aware edits without manual timeline work. Users can batch-process tutorials, generate personalized clips, or embed video editing into AI workflows by defining rules and letting the agent execute the edits.

summaries.en: Herdr is a terminal-based tool that runs and orchestrates multiple AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex) concurrently. Its core innovation is multiplexing agent inputs and outputs, enabling collaborative problem-solving without manual window switching. Built in Rust, it offers fast, reliable performance with low overhead. Developers can use herdr to delegate tasks to different agents, compare their outputs, or combine their strengths—ideal for complex debugging, code generation, or exploratory programming where diverse AI perspectives add value.

summary_short.zh: lingbot-map是一个前馈式的3D基础模型，专为从流式数据（如视频或传感器实时输入）重建场景而设计。与传统的SLAM或离线重建不同，它的前馈架构能够以单次前向传播处理数据，避免了迭代优化，从而在保证鲁棒性的同时实现极低延迟的实时3D理解。这一特性使其特别适用于自动驾驶导航、机器人操作或AR/VR等需要快速感知动态环境的场景。实践中，只需将相机或LiDAR数据流输入模型，即可直接获得稠密的3D重建结果，便于集成到现有感知管线中。

summaries.en: lingbot-map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data, enabling real-time 3D understanding from video or sensor streams. Unlike traditional SLAM or offline reconstruction, its feed-forward architecture processes data in a single pass, avoiding iterative optimization for speed and robustness. This makes it ideal for applications like autonomous navigation, robotic manipulation, or AR/VR where low-latency scene understanding is critical. You can integrate it into a perception pipeline by feeding camera or LiDAR streams and obtain dense 3D reconstructions directly.

summaries.en: FluidVoice is a fast, on-device dictation app for macOS that runs entirely locally, ensuring privacy and low latency. Its core innovation combines a lightweight speech-to-text engine with a custom-trained AI enhancement model that corrects recognition errors in real time, boosting accuracy. summaries.en: **summary_en (96 words)** Astryx is an open-source design system that solves the problem of inconsistent, hard-to-maintain UI across projects while preparing interfaces for AI agents. Its key technical insight is full customizability through a design-token-based theming engine and composable React components, giving teams total control over look and behavior without forking. You can use it to quickly scaffold a branded component library, then extend it with your own tokens or integrate it with LLM-driven UI generators for dynamic, agent-ready interfaces. **summary_zh (145汉字)** Astryx 是一个开源设计系统，专门解决UI开发中一致性差、难以维护的问题，同时让界面天然支持AI智能体。技术上，它通过“设计令牌+可组合组件”的架构实现完全定制——你只需改几个token就能换掉整套主题，无需修改源码。实际使用时，你可以用它快速搭建品牌组件库，再结合LLM驱动的界面生成工具，让AI自动输出符合你设计规范的页面。

summary_short.zh: Instatic 是一款自托管可视化 CMS，可在一分钟内快速部署，简化静态网站内容管理。它融合可视化页面构建器与轻量级 Markdown 后端，无需编码即可实时编辑和发布内容。技术亮点在于将所见即所得编辑体验与静态站点生成器结合，并保持内容可移植性。用户可通过 Docker 或 Node.js 快速运行，连接任意静态站点生成器，实现可视化内容管理工作流。适合小型团队或个人项目，帮助快速搭建带编辑后台的静态网站，运维成本极低。

summaries.en: Instatic is a modern visual CMS you can self-host in under a minute, designed to simplify content management for static websites. Unlike traditional CMSs, it combines a live visual page builder with a lightweight Markdown-based backend, letting you edit and publish content without coding. You can run it as a Docker container or Node.js app, connect it to a static site generator, and manage content visually—perfect for small teams or personal projects wanting a fast, no-fuss editorial workflow.
